screens.title: Where we use them
paras: Squares and square roots are used in carpentry, engineering, building design and technology.
A cube root finds the side of a solid when you know its volume.

screens.title: Five formulas
screens.ask: Tap each card: one formula and how to go back.
items: Area = side × side = s². A side of 5 m gives 25 m².
Side = √Area. An area of 400 m² gives a side of √400 = 20 m.
Volume = s × s × s = s³. A side of 8 cm gives 512 cm³.
Side = ∛Volume. A volume of 512 cm³ gives ∛512 = 8 cm.
A cube has 6 equal square faces. Surface area = 6 × s². A side of 6 cm gives 6 × 36 = 216 cm².

screens.title: The cube in Figure 2.1 (side 6 cm)
steps: Six faces: 6 × 36 = 216 cm². This is the surface area.
The numbers are equal (216), but the units differ: cm² for area, cm³ for volume.

screens.ask: Volume of a cube = side³. The side is 8 cm. Volume = ___ cm³
1225 students stand in a square: the number of rows equals the number in each row. Students in each row = ___
screens.why:
Let x be the number in each row. There are x rows, so x × x = 1225.
So x = √1225.
Prime factors: 1225 = 5 × 5 × 7 × 7 = (5 × 7) × (5 × 7) = 35 × 35.
So there are 35 students in each row.
screens.clue: The number of rows times itself is 1225.

screens.ask: A square room in Bahir Dar has a floor area of 64 m². Each wall is ___ m long
screens.why:
Side = √Area = √64.
8 × 8 = 64.
So each wall is 8 m long.

screens.ask: A cube-shaped box has a volume of 125 cm³. Each edge = ___ cm
screens.why:
Edge = ∛Volume = ∛125.
5 × 5 × 5 = 125.
So each edge is 5 cm.

screens.ask: Surface area of a cube = 6 × side². The side is 4 cm. Surface area = ___ cm²
screens.why:
One face: 4 × 4 = 16 cm².
A cube has 6 faces: 6 × 16 = 96 cm².

screens.ask: Area of a square = side². The side is 6 cm. Area = ___ cm²
Getaneh's garden is a square. Widening it by 1 m and lengthening it by 3 m adds 19 m². The side now is ___ m
screens.why:
Let x be the side now. Area now: x².
New sides: x + 1 and x + 3. New area: (x + 1)(x + 3) = x² + 3x + x + 3 = x² + 4x + 3.
It is 19 more: x² + 4x + 3 = x² + 19.
Take x² from both sides: 4x + 3 = 19, so 4x = 16 and x = 4.
Check: 4 × 4 = 16 and 5 × 7 = 35; 35 − 16 = 19. ✓
screens.clue: Write the new area as (x + 1)(x + 3) and compare it with x² + 19.

items.ask: Figure 2.1: cube with side 6 cm. Surface area = ___ cm²
items.why:
One face 6 × 6 = 36 cm².
Six faces: 6 × 36 = 216 cm².
